Perhaps I can play games at times when my roommate is less likely to be sleeping, or use headphones to minimize noise. I could also talk to my roommate to find a solution that works for both of us, like setting specific quiet hours or finding a time when I can play without disturbing him. I should also reflect on whether my actions are fair. If I were in my roommate's position, would I want someone to play games loudly at 2 AM? Probably not.
